description: Frederik Hendrikbuurt 1885-1890 four-storey front (Houweningenstraat, Van Reigersbergenstraat, Frederik Hendrikstraat 134-154): red-brown brick, 3 axes on ~4.7 m, tall two-light windows with white frames under white dentil lintels, white sill bands, white cornice with consoles, ground storey with a pair of red doors beside a wide window; crowns: one white pediment dormer over the centre axis, sometimes a pointed brick gable with one attic light. Drafted by typeDraft.ts from 57 pands, authored from the strips.

match.note: houweningen-1-31, houweningen-2-38, reigersbergen-1-37, hendrik-134-154 strips (2021-2022); 3DBAG eaves 13.5-14.0 m

pediment-dormer.note: houweningen-1-31 and hendrik-134-154: one white pediment dormer with a finial over the centre of nearly every pand

point-gable.note: houweningen-1-31 pands 2 and 9, hendrik-134-154: a pointed brick gable with one attic light, about 2.6 m over the cornice

roof.evidence: strips 2021-03/2022-04: over the cornice only the dormers and gables stand against the sky; dark slate band behind (hendrik-134-154)
